name: The Shoppes at Canton Marketplace
summary: Canton Marketplace is the only indoor, climate-controlled vendor mall open during Canton Trade Days, featuring handcrafted and curated items in a secure, temperature-controlled environment. The facility offers year-round vendor spaces, free parking, and operates Thursday through Sunday during First Monday Trade Days weekends.
demographics: Canton Marketplace attracts a diverse mix of shoppers visiting the famous Canton Trade Days, including middle-income families, antique collectors, and craft enthusiasts from across Texas and neighboring states. The primary trade area draws from Van Zandt County and surrounding rural communities, with visitors typically ranging from 35-65 years old with moderate household incomes. The center serves both local residents seeking climate-controlled shopping and tourists attending the monthly First Monday Trade Days events, creating a unique blend of regular shoppers and weekend visitors interested in handcrafted goods, vintage items, and artisan products.
description: The Shoppes at Canton Marketplace is the only indoor, climate-controlled vendor mall open during the legendary Canton Trade Days, offering shoppers a comfortable alternative to outdoor browsing. Located at 1455 N. Trade Days Boulevard in Canton, Texas, this unique facility provides year-round vendor spaces where merchants can safely display handcrafted and curated items in a temperature-controlled environment. The marketplace features 24/7 security surveillance, security patrols, and the convenience of allowing vendors to leave merchandise on-site between trade days weekends. Open Thursday through Sunday during First Monday Trade Days (9 AM to 7 PM Thursday-Saturday, 9 AM to 5 PM Sunday), the center offers free parking and showcases a variety of handcrafted products, artisan goods, and unique finds. Beyond shopping, Canton Marketplace provides additional amenities including RV spaces with water, Wi-Fi, laundry, and shower facilities, plus climate-controlled storage units, making it a comprehensive destination for both vendors and visitors attending Canton's famous monthly trade days events.
